scope: Three current-build edited PAPER180 raw screenshots only; separately observed after baseline36. Expected annotation strings come from task contract and do not certify pixel text beyond what is legible.
reviewer: Codex subagent /root/boundary_matrix_pixel_audit; automated actual-pixel review, not human researcher or publication reviewer

environmentScope.screenshots: Every reviewed raw image is 1280 x 720; current DOM viewport individually cross-checked.
environmentScope.userAgent: Earlier same selected IAB observation, as explicitly marked in per-case environmentProvenance; current UA remains unobserved.
environmentScope.currentEnvironmentFile: Not used to generalize its earlier 1102 x 835 state across captures.

limitations: Raw screenshots were actually opened and visually inspected; no pass inferred from helper/status/metadata.
Pixel inspection supports visible contour, selected controls, clipping/modal absence and style, not canonical endpoint or shared/repeat correctness.
Deep-fit tiny labels cannot establish per-node/port/legend readability at publication size.
Physical 85/180 mm readability, real human acceptance, export paint fidelity and presented performance are unverified.
Hash stability links the files reviewed; it does not independently certify screenshot provenance.

cases.method: tools.view_image once for this exact raw screenshot at 1280 by 720 native-file size; AI visual reviewer, not human participant/publication reviewer

pixelObservations.annotationTextReading: The expected wording is visually consistent at overview, but lettering is small/soft. Exact full text must be checked against saved Canvas/SVG in the field audit; no exact-text or physical-size readability proof from pixels.
pixelObservations.previewStyle: Pale category fills and muted routes; matching paper color preset.
pixelObservations.textReadability: Broad stage labels and overview layout recognizable. Fine annotation, ports, parameters and legend text cannot establish canonical semantics or physical publication readability.

cases.result: Visible edited paper, model contour, legend and explanatory box fit inside workspace without modal/clipping. Expected annotation and layout visually consistent; exact bytes and saved/reopened behavior are field-audit scope.
